title: Minimalist chrome — one light look, built

steps.path: Header, message box, quick buttons, status buttons
steps.headline: Every floating control, including the message box, now shares the light frosted look you picked.
steps.changed: Top: header buttons, session switcher and Chat/Terminal switch. Bottom: quick buttons, their edit button, the message box, the status buttons (including Priority) and their edit button. The window buttons became one pill, like Chat/Terminal. Bottom text now takes a pale colour read from the wallpaper behind it; Sonnet keeps its orange.
steps.notice: Each picture is the top of the window, a white gap, then the bottom — two views of one screen, not a bar.
steps.risk: The quick-buttons edit button is now a small rounded square, matching the status bar's edit button, instead of a pale green circle.

steps.headline: An open Files or Games panel shows as selected: a lifted, lighter pill, matching the selected Chat segment.
steps.changed: The solid accent fill used to vanish under the light look. Selected Files/Games and the selected Chat segment now share one selected style.
steps.notice: Files is open in this picture (top right). Compare it with the Chat segment on the left.
steps.risk: The selected Chat segment is slightly more defined than before, because it now matches Files and Games.
